# Malibu

> Malibu is a network that turns idle Apple Silicon Macs into the world's largest AI cloud. It pays providers to keep open-source models warm and ready, serves buyers through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, and settles weekly in USDC on Base. Every response ships a signed, cryptographically verifiable inference receipt.

## Blog

- [Turning on the world's biggest AI cloud](https://malibu.tech/blog/turning-on-the-worlds-biggest-ai-cloud/): The manifesto — why 200M idle Apple Silicon Macs already hold more consumer AI compute than the top three hyperscalers combined, and how Malibu turns it on.

## Product

- [Host a model](https://malibu.tech/host/): Turn a stock Apple Silicon Mac into a paid inference provider with one command.
- [Console](https://malibu.tech/console/): Point any OpenAI SDK client at Malibu; nothing else changes.
- [Network](https://malibu.tech/network/): Live network stats and coverage.
